property_summary: For any fuzzed bytes4 input, C.supportsInterface must return true for the ERC1155MetadataURI interface id (0x0e89341c); the mutant drops that check and returns false, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Remove the check for the IERC1155MetadataURI interface id, so callers querying type(IERC1155MetadataURI).interfaceId now get false instead of true.
